origin.description: Stable collation sort. The default drops missing strings. A leading BOM is removed from each result. Numbers are coerced with as.character first.
origin.usage: stri_sort(str, decreasing = FALSE, na_last = NA, ..., opts_collator = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vectors, or objects coerced with as.character. NA stays missing. The string "NA" is text.

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: One logical value. FALSE sorts weakly increasing. TRUE sorts weakly decreasing. NA is an error.

arguments.name: na_last
arguments.text: TRUE puts missing strings last, FALSE puts them first, and NA drops them. stri_sort defaults to NA. stri_order defaults to TRUE.

arguments.name: opts_collator
arguments.text: A named list from stri_opts_collator, or NULL. Extra arguments are passed through stri_opts_collator.

origin.details: Stable collation sort. The default drops missing strings. A leading BOM is removed from each result. Numbers are coerced with as.character first. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key.
origin.value: The vector stringi returns for this function. JSON null in the captured check is NA.

translation.description: Stable collation sort. The default drops missing strings. A leading BOM is removed from each result. Numbers are coerced with as.character first.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those. None is an empty vector. None inside a list is NA.

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: One logical value. FALSE sorts weakly increasing. TRUE sorts weakly decreasing. NA is an error.

arguments.name: na_last
arguments.text: TRUE puts missing strings last, FALSE puts them first, and NA drops them. stri_sort defaults to NA. stri_order defaults to TRUE.

arguments.name: opts_collator
arguments.text: A dict of supplied settings, or None. Keywords are merged with stri_opts_collator. normalisation is stored as normalization.

translation.details: Stable collation sort. The default drops missing strings. A leading BOM is removed from each result. Numbers are coerced with as.character first. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key. Collation uses PyICU.
translation.value: A list. A bare string is a length-one list. NA is stringi._na.NA.
